text:
ida: Verdant AI just went GA on Azure Marketplace with a Redwood Private offer preinstalled — they signed the co-sell package and included a 12‑month reserved capacity commitment. Big win for regulated health customers. :tada:

mike: amazing work everyone. do we know which runtime/version shipped with the marketplace image?

ida: it's runtime v2.1.0 with our quantization profile for A100 and KV-cache prewarm enabled. we also included the policy controls so customers can opt into on-prem mode.

jen: love that. can we get a short case blurb for marketing? 2–3 lines on latency improvements and data isolation.

sam: @ida tagging for the deal notes — initial committed ARR + potential upsell for Dedicated in Q4. also they asked for a joint case study focusing on HIPAA controls.

vera: shoutout to partnerships + engineering on quick turnaround. can we prepare a 1‑pager and an internal FAQ? I can route a short customer quote for the case study. :rocket:

ben: legal signed off on the SOW today. flagged one minor DPA tweak for Azure Marketplace terms; will drop the redline into the drive. :white_check_mark:

mike: ops note — there was a small init script tweak required for the marketplace VM image. snippet we used:
```
#!/bin/bash
redwoodctl register --org verdant-ai --env prod
redwoodctl apply-config --file /etc/redwood/marketplace-defaults.yaml
```

ida: posting assets here: <https://redwood.internal/partnerships/verdant-ga> (1‑pager, sample quote, deploy notes). please react if you need edits.

partnerships-bot: Press release scheduled for 2026-04-08 15:00 PT. Slack announcement draft in #marketing for review.

sam: customer asked about Dedicated conversion path — we have a migration playbook. pinging eng-sre for capacity planning this week.

vera: next steps: 1) finalize 1‑pager (jen) 2) marketing draft (ida + partnerships) 3) case study interview (customer + sam) 4) internal runbook + KB (mike). I'll own the timeline.

jen: I'll have a marketing blurb + short tech stat (20–40% latency win vs their baseline) by EOD tomorrow.

mike: ops will prep the marketplace image patch and include the checked-in deploy script. ETA 48h.

ida: thanks team — big win for the Marketplace and our Private product motion. please drop reactions and any follow-ups in the thread. :clap:
